 is_valid = { owner = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled } NOT = { sed_groceries_candidate_eligible = yes } NOT = { has_variable = sed_groceries_request_pending } }
 effect = { if = { limit = { owner = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled } NOT = { sed_groceries_candidate_eligible = yes } NOT = { has_variable = sed_groceries_request_pending } } owner = { sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes } } }
}

 is_shown = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled any_scope_state = { OR = { has_variable = sed_railway_ignored has_variable = sed_construction_ignored has_variable = sed_wood_ignored has_variable = sed_iron_ignored has_variable = sed_coal_ignored has_variable = sed_grain_ignored has_variable = sed_fabric_ignored has_variable = sed_tools_ignored has_variable = sed_groceries_ignored has_variable = sed_clothes_ignored has_variable = sed_small_arms_ignored has_variable = sed_artillery_ignored has_variable = sed_ammunition_ignored } } }
 is_valid = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled any_scope_state = { OR = { has_variable = sed_railway_ignored has_variable = sed_construction_ignored has_variable = sed_wood_ignored has_variable = sed_iron_ignored has_variable = sed_coal_ignored has_variable = sed_grain_ignored has_variable = sed_fabric_ignored has_variable = sed_tools_ignored has_variable = sed_groceries_ignored has_variable = sed_clothes_ignored has_variable = sed_small_arms_ignored has_variable = sed_artillery_ignored has_variable = sed_ammunition_ignored } } }
 effect = { sed_restore_ignored = yes }
}
